Dow Announces Full Redemption of All Outstanding 4.125% Notes Due 2021. Dow Inc. announced a full redemption of its 4.125% Notes due 2021 issued pursuant to an Indenture dated as of May 1, 2008 between TDCC and The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A., as trustee. As of the date of issuance of the redemption notice, there was $1,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of such Notes outstanding. Pursuant to the terms of the Indenture, such remaining outstanding Notes will be redeemed in full on November 12, 2019 at a redemption price equal to the greater of (1) 100% of the principal amount thereof, and (2) the sum of the present values of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest thereon (not including any portion of such interest payments accrued as of the Redemption Date), discounted to the Redemption Date on a semiannual basis (assuming a 360-day year consisting of twelve 30-day months) at the Treasury Rate (as defined in the Notes and determined on the third business day prior to the Redemption Date) plus 35 basis points, as set forth in the Notes, along with accrued and unpaid interest up to, but not including, the Redemption Date. On the Redemption Date and upon TDCC’s payment of the redemption price, all rights of holders with respect to the Notes being redeemed will terminate, except for the right to receive payment of the applicable redemption price upon surrender of the Notes for redemption.

Dow Inc. Reports Unaudited Consolidated Earnings Results for the Three Months and Consolidated and Proforma Earnings Results for the Nine Months Ended September 30, 2019. Dow Inc. reported unaudited consolidated earnings results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2019. For the three months, the company reported net sales of $10,764 million against $12,634 million a year ago. Interest income was $19 million against $22 million a year ago. Net income was $347 million against $1,049 million a year ago. Earnings per share basic were $0.45 against $1.36 a year ago.For the nine months, the company reported net sales of $32,747 million against $37,660 million a year ago. Interest income was $58 million against $60 million a year ago. Net income was $1,038 million against $3,852 million a year ago. Earnings per share basic were $1.29 against $5.02 a year ago.For the nine months on proforma basis, the company reported net sales of $32,794 million against $37,844 million a year ago. Interest income was $59 million against $60 million a year ago. Net income from continuing operations available for company common stockholders was $584 million against $2,475 million a year ago. Earnings per share basic from continuing operations were $0.78 against $3.31 a year ago.

ALTIVIA Ketones & Additives, LLC completed the acquisition of Acetone Derivatives Business from Dow Inc.. ALTIVIA Ketones & Additives, LLC entered into an agreement to acquire Acetone Derivatives Business from Dow Inc. (NYSE:DOW) on August 13, 2019. The acquisition includes production assets located in Institute, West Virginia, in addition to the site infrastructure, land and utilities. Dow will remain a tenant on the Institute site, retaining ownership of certain manufacturing assets. The transaction is expected to close by the end of 2019, subject to customary closing conditions.
